'''Operative Simmons''' is a member of [[SI:7]] in [[Stormwind Harbor]]. With his riding gryphon [[Steelwing]], he provides transportation to the [[SI:7 Outpost]] on the island of [[Balor]].

If you wish to join us on our operation on [[Balor]], my steadfast gryphon [[Steelwing]] can bring you there.
